description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git rebase --signoff' and related options. It sets up git repositories, performs rebases with different options, and checks that commit messages contain or omit sign-off lines as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the given commands, and verifies success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting them to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Checks the commit message of the current HEAD against an expected value.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets a fake editor to simulate user editing during rebase.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
